About.title: Don't take a mortgage blindly.
About.hook: A mortgage is probably the largest financial commitment you'll ever make. My goal is to help you make decisions based on clear economic reasoning, so you can save tens of thousands of shekels and sleep soundly.
About.story_text: I started out inside the banking system as a telephone banker. That is where I understood exactly how the system works from the inside — how the bank prices risks, its margins, and where you can really push in negotiations. After seeing the average client get lost facing the system, I decided to switch sides and represent you.
About.education_text: I hold a BA in Economics and Business Administration, and I have a background as a Full Stack Developer. Although I do not practice these fields today, the analytical thinking I acquired allows me to analyze numbers with precision, calculate scenarios, and build accurate simulations that save a lot of money.
About.approach_text: I am not a salesperson; I am an analyst. I believe in rigorous data analysis, utilizing advanced technological tools, and deep market understanding — instead of acting on guesswork. Decisions are based on total transparency.
